newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tingyi to launch US$150 mln FRN issue.
newsitem.headline: Tingyi to launch US$150 mln FRN issue.

text.p: Instant noodle maker Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holdings confirmed Monday that it plans to issue approximately US$150 million in floating rate notes.
The notes will be issued by the company and guaranteed by substantially all of the wholly owned subsidiaries of the company, Tingyi said in an announcement.
The company will seek to have the notes listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
Barings Brothers Ltd is the underwriter for the issue, Tingyi said.

It said proceeds of the issue will be used to finance the acquisition by the company and its subsidiaries of machinery and equipment to expand production facilities and to repay a portion of the company's short-term debt.
Bankers said last week that the issue is expected to have a final maturity of three years.
